title: What Matters in Evaluating Book-Length Stories? A Systematic Study of Long Story Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the distribution of user reviews across 1-5 star rating scales to identify the underrepresentation of moderate ratings (e.g., 2-star and 3-star reviews), and measuring the performance impact of mitigating this bias by filtering training reviews to match the actual rating distribution.

Incorporated as a qualitative aspect within the hierarchical evaluation criteria structure to assess how individual preferences, subjective feelings, and personal experiences influence a reader's or model's evaluation of a story.
